element_title: Tree canopy and deep soil areas
title: Tree canopy and deep soil areas Element Objectives
text: O 3.3.1 Site planning maximises retention of existing healthy and appropriate trees and protects the viability of adjoining trees. O 3.3.2 Adequate measures are taken to improve tree canopy (long term) or to offset reduction of tree canopy from pre-development condition. O 3.3.3 Development includes deep soil areas, or other infrastructure to support planting on structures, with sufficient area and volume to sustain healthy plant and tree growth.
notes: Unchanged. O 3.3.3 is interleaved with A3.3.5 and A3.3.1 in the extract; check against the rendered page.
